about_the_game:
Ready To Make Some Noise?

Meowzic Survivor is a rhythm-action roguelike that fuses the addictive wave-survival gameplay of survivor-like genre with rhythm game mechanics. Dive into a synthwave dreamscape brought to life with vibrant pixel art and neon lights, where heroic cats armed with beat based weapons battle through various dance floors of pure chaos. Every blast of rhythm-fueled power is timed to the music itself.

Core Gameplay

Master the unique combat system where all weapons are entirely beat-based—your firepower flows directly from the rhythm. Manipulate BPM to your advantage and build your combat music with weapons of your choice. Survive relentless enemy hordes while completing rhythm-focused minigames that grant powerful temporary abilities. And each cat fighter brings their own style.

Key Features:

  • Beat-synchronized combat that makes every action feel musical

  • Face off against challenging bosses that test both your rhythm skills and survival instincts.

  • Unlock and play as various cats, each with unique weapons and traits.

  • Survive procedurally intense battles through synthwave dreamscapes and uncover upgrades that transform your feline warrior.

  • Complete rhythm minigames mid-combat to turn the tide of battle.

  • Progress through musical chaos brought to life in stunning pixel art to rescue your human master.

Whether you're a rhythm game enthusiast, a roguelike fan, or someone looking for a fresh take on action gameplay, Meowzic Survivor delivers an experience where timing, music, and mayhem collide.

short_description: A rhythm-action roguelike where cute feline warriors harness the power of music to survive waves of enemies in a synthwave world. Control rhythms and manipulating BPM to master combat, defeat bosses, and rescue your human master—all brought to life in vibrant pixel art and neon lights.
